thesis: Coherent is a primary beneficiary of AI datacenter optics: Q3 FY2026 revenue $1.81B (+21% y/y, +27% pro forma), Datacenter & Communications at 75% of revenue growing 41% y/y, record bookings with backlog visibility to calendar 2028, and a landmark NVIDIA partnership ($2B equity stake plus multiyear co-packaged-optics supply agreement). The offset: free cash flow is currently negative (capex consuming ~70% of operating cash flow) and the stock, even after a -9.5% week, prices a flawless 1.6T/CPO ramp.
catalysts: Q4 FY2026 results (August 2026): guidance $1.91-2.05B revenue, non-GAAP EPS $1.52-1.72
NVIDIA $2B equity investment plus multiyear CPO supply agreement (announced with Q3 FY26 results, May 2026)
1.6T transceiver ramp - management expects margin accretion
AI order backlog extending through calendar 2028
Co-packaged optics adoption inflection (timing is the swing factor both ways)
risk_factors: Negative TTM free cash flow: -$58M FCF in Q3 despite $225M net income; capex intensity may persist through the build-out
Valuation leaves no tolerance for weaker AI capex, slower CPO adoption, or margin disappointment (stock fell 7.4% on earnings day despite a beat)
Optical networking competition (Lumentum, InnoLight, in-house hyperscaler programs) and customer concentration in AI capex
CPO transition risk cuts both ways: if it slips, near-term catalysts vanish; if it accelerates, pluggable transceiver revenue cannibalizes
Beta 2.04; the June-July pullback shows how fast AI-optics multiple compression arrives

q3_fy2026_revenue.note: +21% y/y reported, +27% pro forma; non-GAAP GM 39.6%, non-GAAP EPS 1.41, net income ~225M
q3_fy2026_revenue.source: Coherent Q3 FY2026 results (StockTitan/Motley Fool transcript)

q3_fy2026_fcf.note: negative despite 225M net income; capex ~70% of operating cash flow; TTM FCF negative
